purpose: Acquire and classify human-made high-altitude sky-event calendars that could contribute to STARLIKE/compact-light reports or photographic candidates, while explicitly separating positive-event manifests from true no-event denominators.

SOUNDING_ROCKETS.primary_authority: NASA Technical Reports Server / World Data Center A
SOUNDING_ROCKETS.published_scope: Cumulative listing starts with V-2 launch 1947-03-07 and extends through 1971-12-31.
SOUNDING_ROCKETS.critical_population_boundary: NASA describes the catalogue as scientifically successful rockets identified from various sources. It is therefore a positive-event manifest, not an all-attempt denominator.
SOUNDING_ROCKETS.negative_date_semantics: FORBIDDEN until an official all-launch/attempt/failure opportunity source is acquired for the same temporal/geographic scope.
required_fields_before_join: scientific-success selection flag inherited from catalogue
SOUNDING_ROCKETS.required_upgrade_for_rate_or_negative_co: Independent official all-launch/firing record including failed/unsuccessful attempts or an explicitly documented launch-opportunity denominator.

HIGH_ALTITUDE_BALLOONS_GENETRIX_119L.primary_authority: CIA FOIA release of SAC Historical Study 62, History of 1st Air Division, Volume 2
HIGH_ALTITUDE_BALLOONS_GENETRIX_119L.document_scope: Project/Weapons System 119L primary mission and related operational activity.

prejoin_facts_frozen_from_authority_text.subsequent_launch_policy: balloons launched daily subject to directed limits, political constraints and surface weather

HIGH_ALTITUDE_BALLOONS_GENETRIX_119L.critical_population_boundary: Operational prose establishes launch opportunity and interruptions but does not by itself expose every daily launch count in the currently parsed HTML. A daily event manifest must be recovered from the study statistics/IBM tables or another official companion source before date-level inference.
HIGH_ALTITUDE_BALLOONS_GENETRIX_119L.negative_date_semantics: A day inside the operation is not automatically a no-launch day. Only explicit zero-launch/stand-down dates from a complete daily manifest may be used as negative controls.

cross_channel_future_design.bluebook: STARLIKE/COMPACT_LIGHT event-day and geography-aware enrichment only after the event manifest's negative-date semantics are admitted.
cross_channel_future_design.poss: Candidate rate only on actually observed Palomar nights; no unobserved calendar zeros.
cross_channel_future_design.geography: Mandatory when launch site and witness location are available; date-only coincidence cannot establish contamination by a local human-made event.
cross_channel_future_design.shared_trigger_rule: A human-made event family is not a shared explanation unless independent human and photographic endpoints survive frozen nulls in compatible direction and the event calendar has explicit opportunity/completeness.

forbidden: No use of NASA scientifically-successful-only catalogue absences as no-launch dates.
No use of Genetrix operational-window dates as launch dates without daily launch evidence.
No cherry-picking famous V-2, rocket or balloon events after looking at STARLIKE/POSS dates.
No mixing rocket and balloon families into one exposure before separate family results exist.
No Blue Book or POSS outcome access during source acquisition/schema/completeness gates.
next_gates: Freeze NASA NTRS and CIA FOIA source bytes/metadata independently of outcomes.
Acquire a row-level rocket positive-event table and determine whether an official all-attempt denominator can be recovered.
Recover Genetrix daily launch-count/stand-down statistics from official source material and freeze them before any outcome join.
Only then preregister JPFM-4B rocket and balloon association tests separately.
